root_cause.text: In `drivers/net/wireless/realtek/rtlwifi/rtl8192cu/trx.c`, `rtl92cu_tx_fill_desc()` used the TID returned by `ieee80211_get_tid(hdr)` directly as an index into `sta_entry->tids[]` without validating that it was below `MAX_TID_COUNT`, causing an out-of-bounds array access when the TID was larger than the table size.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `agg_state = sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state;` to `if (tid < MAX_TID_COUNT) agg_state = sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state;`, and the commit message says TID from `ieee80211_get_tid()` “might be out of range of array size of sta_entry->tids[]” with UBSAN reporting `index 10 is out of range for type 'rtl_tid_data [9]'`.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch changes `agg_state = sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state;` to `if (tid < MAX_TID_COUNT) agg_state = sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state;`, and the commit message says TID from `ieee80211_get_tid()` “might be out of range of array size of sta_entry->tids[]” with UBSAN reporting `index 10 is out of range for type 'rtl_tid_data [9]'`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a bounds check before accessing per-TID aggregation state to prevent invalid array indexing.
intent_record.what: The code adds a conditional check before reading `sta_entry->tids[tid].agg.agg_state`, so the aggregation state is only accessed when `tid < MAX_TID_COUNT`.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents an out-of-bounds array access if the extracted TID is invalid or too large, avoiding undefined behavior while leaving `agg_state` unchanged when the check fails.

grouping_result.intent: Add a bounds check before accessing per-TID aggregation state to prevent invalid array indexing.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly matches the vulnerability root cause: it adds a bounds check before indexing per-TID state, preventing the out-of-bounds access caused by using an unchecked TID value.

candidates.rationale: This statement directly indexes sta_entry->tids[] with tid returned from ieee80211_get_tid(hdr) without any bounds check, which can cause an out-of-bounds access when tid >= MAX_TID_COUNT.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement directly uses tid as an index into sta_entry->tids[] without a bounds check, matching the root cause of an out-of-bounds array access when tid is greater than or equal to MAX_TID_COUNT.
